title: Aardvark-Vanaheim Cerebus #82 January 1986 Comic Book ISSN 0712-7774 - Dave Sim
descriptionText: The Aardvark-Vanaheim Cerebus #82 January 1986 Comic Book is a vintage collectible featuring the character Cerebus by artist/writer Dave Sim. This single unit comic book is part of the series "Cerebus the Aardvark" and was published by Aardvark-Vanaheim in the United States during the Copper Age. The comic is not signed, but it is boarded and in English language. With its superhero and comedic elements, this comic is a prized possession for fans of the genre.
